title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p4bl: 8 unit test failures in lichen-oscore after API changes
description:
Commit ff40b86 ('project-LICHEN-worker6-p4bl: fix') changed several public APIs in lichen-oscore:
- protect_response now requires an additional 'include_piv: bool' parameter
- Context::new now takes id_context as third argument (previously omitted)
- OscoreSeqNum::new returns Option<OscoreSeqNum> instead of OscoreSeqNum
- Context::load_existing removed in favor of Context::new().restore_existing()

8 unit tests in lib.rs fail because their call sites were not updated to match the new signatures:
1. delayed_explicit_piv_ordinary_response_ignores_peer_replay_window
2. dropped_pending_response_preserves_committed_window_across_large_jump
3. fresh_context_activates_only_after_atomic_registration
4. oversized_explicit_piv_response_does_not_poison_valid_retry
5. public_unprotect_rejects_malformed_inner_options
6. response_without_piv_is_one_shot_per_request
7. response_without_piv_requires_requester_identity
8. test_roundtrip_with_0xff_in_class_e_options

All 10 integration tests in tests/vectors.rs pass (including rewritten test_request_protection_vectors and test_response_protection_vectors which now use hardcoded independent oracles).
